name: Beat the Beast: Griffin's Gold - Reborn
review:
A revival of the series finale on a 3x5 grid with 9 lines. The bonus game gives free spins with roaming wilds and a wild multiplier that climbs as it goes.

It has the biggest ceiling in the Beat the Beast series at 22,222x. Very high volatility, 96.14% RTP. Built for players who want a long shot at a huge result.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
